result.summary: The UI appears largely functional, but there is a notable layout/alignment issue with the 'Popular right now' restaurant card.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section has a mismatched style where the content within the card is essentially just a full-width image, making the bottom information (title, rating, delivery time) look detached or floating outside of the intended card container.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card component to ensure the text details are contained within a clear, bounded card background that is visually consistent with the other restaurant cards.
